Sets this age's value.[n]Applies only when the matching Pace Settings row is set to Custom. Pace Set presets fill these rows; changing one switches Pace Set to Custom.
Age Progress Rate

How quickly the age meter fills. Each Legacy Path milestone, and each future tech or civic, adds points to it; Age Length sets the total that ends the age.[n]Milestone figures are the first, second, and third of each age.
Technology Cost
Sets how much Science each technology costs. Higher costs stretch an age out; lower costs let you race down the tree.
Civic Cost
Sets how much Culture each civic costs. Higher costs stretch an age out; lower costs let you race down the tree.
City Growth
Sets how much Food a city needs for each new citizen. Lower thresholds let cities climb past size 10 far sooner.
Roads
Sets how much Movement it costs to travel along roads and railroads. Cheaper roads let armies cross your territory in far fewer turns.
Victory Project Cost
Sets the Production cost of the 12 science and military Victory Projects, from Chart The Stars to Crewed Space Flight.
